items.title: Role of the Missouri River in the US Agricultural Supply Chain
items.quote: Supply Chain Fun Fact! While taking off from St Louis yesterday I captured this nice view of the Missouri River! It functions as a major artery for agricultural goods, fertilizer, and energy products.

items.title: Air Freight for Perishable Goods Like Raspberries

tags.label: short shelf life of delicate produce

items.quote: 💡Supply Chain Fun Fact 💡 Believe it or not, those juicy raspberries you love might be living the high life in Canada! Forget hopping on a truck, these berries travel first class – by airplane! Here's the juicy details: since these delicate fruits bruise easily and don't last long (average shelf life around 3-5 days), Canadian stores far from the farms get their stock flown in. That's right, next time you pop a raspberry in your mouth, imagine it cruising at 30,000 feet just a few days earlier.
